# SpeedFit Chennai


> SpeedFit is a personal training brand founded and led by Coach Thousief Khan, based in Chennai, India, offering elite fat loss, muscle building, and posture-correction coaching in person in Chennai and online worldwide.


## Facts
- Founder & Coach: Thousief Khan — Certified Athletic Performance Coach, Fat Loss & Body Composition Specialist
- Experience: 6+ years coaching, 100+ documented client transformations
- Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India (in-person); online coaching available worldwide
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +91 90256 58178
- Website: https://www.thespeedfit.com/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/speedfit_2.0 (brand) and https://instagram.com/thousiefkhan (coach)


## Services
- Digital Workout + Diet Plan: custom workout programme and Indian diet plan delivered via WhatsApp within 24 hours
- Online Personal Coaching: 1-on-1 remote coaching, daily WhatsApp check-ins, weekly progress reviews, video form checks — available worldwide
- In-Person Personal Training (Chennai): face-to-face 1-on-1 sessions, custom Indian diet plan, posture correction, limited monthly slots


## Method
SpeedFit's coaching system: Assess (body, lifestyle, food habits, injuries, stress) → Programme (custom training + Indian diet plan) → Coach (form correction, daily accountability) → Adjust (weekly data review of weight, measurements, photos).


## Differentiators
- All nutrition plans use Indian foods (rice, roti, dal, sabzi) — no imported supplements or foreign diet templates
- Every programme is individually assessed and built — not a copy-paste template
- Daily accountability via an exclusive SpeedFit client app tracking diet, workouts, and progress
- Online clients receive the same daily check-ins and weekly reviews as in-person clients
